description: This PHP class 'ModulesCest' contains automated acceptance tests for the /api/v8/modules API endpoints of a SuiteCRM project, including CRUD operations, relationship management, filtering, and file attachments, using the Codeception testing framework.

classes.name: ModulesCest
classes.description: Contains acceptance test methods for the /api/v8/modules API endpoints, covering CRUD operations, relationships, filters, and file attachments in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: TestScenarioListModules
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the list of modules available via the API.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingType
methods.description: Tests API response when creating a resource with missing 'type' field.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingAttributes
methods.description: Tests API response when creating a resource with missing required attributes.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingRequiredFields
methods.description: Tests API response when creating a resource missing required fields.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNew
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new 'Accounts' resource and captures its ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNewWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Tests creating a new 'Accounts' resource using client credentials grant authentication.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateExisting
methods.description: Tests API response when attempting to create an existing resource (should fail).

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNoteWithAttachment
methods.description: Creates a 'Notes' resource with an attachment and validates retrieval.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateDocumentWithAttachment
methods.description: Creates a 'Documents' resource with an attachment and validates retrieval.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific 'Accounts' resource by ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing 'Accounts' resource's attributes.

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specific 'Accounts' resource by ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'Accounts' resources.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveFilteredList
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of 'Accounts' based on date_entered.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateProductWithAnOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Creates 'AOS_Product_Categories' and 'AOS_Products' with relationship.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship link between a product and its category.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateAnOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Creates a relationship from a product to a category.

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Updates (relates) a product to a new category.

methods.name: TestScenarioClearOneToManyRelationshipUsingRelationshipLink
methods.description: Removes the relationship between a product and its category via relationship link.

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Deletes (detaches) the relationship between a product and category.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Creates multiple product records and relates them to a category (many-to-many).

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves related products for a product category (many-to-many).

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Replaces the related products for a category (many-to-many).

methods.name: TestScenarioClearManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Clears all related products from a category (many-to-many).

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Removes specific products from category relationships (many-to-many).

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateMeetingsWithUsersAndMiddleTableFields
methods.description: Creates a meeting with invitees and verifies group relationship fields with middle table data (currently commented out).
